title: WW3-SWRT: WAVEWATCH III 7.14 with the sparse Webb-Resio-Tracy (SWRT) nonlinear source term
description:
WAVEWATCH III (version 7.14) with the sparse Webb–Resio–Tracy (SWRT) source term for the nonlinear four-wave interaction, selected by the switch NL6. SWRT keeps K mirror-image pairs of configurations of the WRT integration space, each with an optimized gain; the main operator has K = 30.

The archive contains the model source (SWRT in model/src/w3snl6md.F90), the switch file, the K = 30 operator, and the namelists and scripts of a 1° global test. The large restart and ERA5 wind inputs of the test are not included.

Since v1.1, the archive also holds the scripts that make the operator for another spectral grid (tools/): WRT's quadrature for the grid, the table of its rows, synthetic practice spectra, the selection of the configurations and their gains, and checks against WRT. For the paper's grid they reproduce the K = 30 operator file exactly. v1.1 also adds the Xnl source files of WRT (NL2), which v1.0 lacked.

v1.2 adds the setups of the six single-point simulations of the paper (single_point/), with a patch that restores the semi-implicit source-term integration and the standard DIA used in them, and the SWRT operators for all other K of the paper (inputs/operators/). Built with the patch, the archived code reproduces the paper's single-point runs with WRT and DIA bit for bit, and those with SWRT to within 1e-6.
